name: Max Kazemi
description: I’m a software engineer with more than eight years of experience building web products, SaaS and internal tools. I build frontend platforms with React and TypeScript, design reusable component systems and SDKs, and build Node.js APIs and multi-tenant integrations. My work includes partner settings and support portals, merchant tools and Shopify storefront components. I co-founded a Shopify SaaS product, led frontend modernisation and mentored engineers. I contribute to open source through npm packages and technical writing.
knowsAbout: Frontend architecture and reusable component systems
REST and GraphQL API design and integration
Monorepos, GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD

subjectOf.name: Faster fintech partner onboarding
subjectOf.description: Built a configurable Node.js and TypeScript orchestration layer that reduced partner onboarding from approximately eight weeks to two weeks.

subjectOf.name: Partner settings and support portals
subjectOf.description: Built and improved React portals covering 35 partner integrations, including permissions and audit workflows. Designed shared components reused across projects and raised settings-portal test coverage from approximately 20% to 80%.

subjectOf.name: Shopify storefront and merchant tooling
subjectOf.description: Co-founded a Shopify SaaS product and built a React and TypeScript widget editor with live previews and undo/redo. Used Web Components and Shadow DOM in storefront tooling to isolate merchant widgets and support theme customisation.

subjectOf.name: Cross-team frontend architecture and leadership
subjectOf.description: Led a 12-person cross-functional team and onboarded and mentored two engineers. Introduced shared component and state patterns adopted by six engineers across two teams, supported by documentation, reviews and migration guidance.

subjectOf.name: Frontend modernisation and performance
subjectOf.description: Led a jQuery-to-React migration into reusable monorepo packages. Combined with new end-to-end test infrastructure, the work reduced manual testing time by around 80%. Improved page-load and interaction latency by around 40%, measured with real-user monitoring and performance traces.

subjectOf.name: Python merchant migration service
subjectOf.description: Built a Python import and export service that lets merchants migrate product bundles from other Shopify apps.

subjectOf.name: Engineering standards and mentoring
subjectOf.description: As interim CTO of a five-person team, set developer onboarding, coding and testing standards, mentored engineers and organised work around their strengths.

subjectOf.name: AI-assisted engineering and quality
subjectOf.description: Built agents for documentation updates, static checks and end-to-end testing. Established peer review, testing and CI checks for AI-generated code and led an AI engineering workshop for 45 engineers.

subjectOf.name: Open-source maintenance and community contributions
subjectOf.description: Maintains the React Scroll Direction npm package, contributed fixes to Shopify Polaris and the TypeScript website, and published more than 300 answers on Stack Overflow.
